title: John Handy and Sylvester: Lizana helped a young man get started
summary: The interviewer says John Handy told him about Lizana; Lizana does not recall him clearly but the younger Handy credited him with help.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels

blocks.x: All right. Good. I've been hearing about you for so many years now. It's been, I guess, eight years now I've been hearing about you. Something like that. You know, from the Brunies boys and different people that took up after you, you know, that they admire. A clarinet player from the name of John Handy that told me about you.
John Handy is an old time. I guess John Handy, I don't know if I remember him. He was an old man when I was a young one.
If I can remember right, I think Johnny was a base player.
Might have been. But from up in past, Chris and Jan.
Mm-hmm. Yeah. They were all born in past. I'm pretty sure they were. They were an old relative.
Johnny and Sylvester and you. The young one told me that you helped him out to get started in the barber. That's how I knew it must be you when you said you were a barber.
I've done a little bit of everything and nothing much of a knife.
